blocks.text: Why seo keyword tracking in sheets is a manual bottleneck

Most consultants spend their day jumping between browser tabs. You have Ahrefs in one tab and a massive sheet in another. You copy a ranking, switch apps, and paste it. This process is slow. It creates a high cognitive load.

The main issue is the gap between your tools. You need to bridge your research with your documentation. When you use Lazur, you keep your eyes on the data. You tell your Mac what to write. You do not hunt for the cursor.
Setting up your Mac for efficient keyword tracking

Your Mac is a powerful machine, but it needs a clean setup. Start by organizing your Chrome tabs. Use a dedicated window for your keyword sheets. Keep your research tools in a separate window. This prevents accidental data entry in the wrong place.

items: Open your tracking sheet in Chrome.
Use ⌘ 1 through ⌘ 8 to switch between your open tabs.
Keep your primary sheet in the first tab for quick access.
Use Lazur to find specific formulas if you forget the syntax.

blocks.text: Reducing the communication tax on your daily flow

Consultants act as a bridge between technical data and client goals. This is where the communication tax hits. You spend hours writing status updates. Use dictation to draft these emails. Hold the fn key and speak your update. Lazur ensures the text is formatted and ready to send.

If you handle client data, ensure you follow your employer's internal security policies. Never dictate sensitive PII into public tools. Lazur does not store your voice data, but your firm's rules still apply.

blocks.text: Technical audits are the heaviest time sink. You crawl a site and then move data to sheets. This is repetitive. Instead of clicking through menus, ask Lazur to guide you. When you are in Screaming Frog, ask where the export settings are. Lazur circles the button for you.
Advanced tips for seo keyword tracking in sheets

Use conditional formatting to spot ranking drops. If you have a large dataset, use filters. You can use the menu path Data > Create a filter. If you get stuck with complex formulas, ask Lazur to explain them. It will tell you how to structure your VLOOKUP or QUERY functions.

items: Use [Freeze the top row](/how-to/freeze-the-top-row-in-google-sheets) to keep headers visible.

Use [Find and Replace](/how-to/find-and-replace-text-in-google-sheets) to clean up messy keyword labels.

blocks.text: What to do when you hit a wall

Every consultant reaches a point where the data makes no sense. Do not force it. Take a break. Use Lazur to set a timer. When you return, ask Lazur to summarize your last few steps. This helps you maintain continuity without keeping a manual log.

Reports should not take hours. Create a template in Sheets. Once it is built, use it for every client. When you need to add a new month of data, use your voice to dictate the numbers. It is faster than typing.
